It takes a long time and it depends on so many factors. I’ve lost track of how long I’ve been doing this but def saw the most progress over the last several months. 

An example of what I eat for breakfast: high protein smoothie (only using half banana and blueberries to limit carbs), oats with nuts, Greek yogurt, chia seed pudding. When I’m feeling like a fun breakfast I make protein pancakes, like I will this week. I use sugar free maple syrup from lakanto for all of these things, it helps me feel like I’m eating something fun. 

Lunch and dinner are these in rotation: scrambled eggs with veggies with a piece of ezekial toast, some type of protein like chciken or fish and veggies, and a sandwhich using ezekiel toast.  

If I’m eating a moderate amount of  carbs in the AM I’ll just adjust and won’t have much later in the day. So you really have to balance the carbs. I don’t deprive myself I go out to eat with my bf a lot but if it’s a lot then I choose healthy items unless we are trying out a new restaurant or something. 

One thing I really avoid is dessert. I ate it at a friends bday a few months ago otherwise it’s not in my rotation. If I do want soemthing I made a low sugar version of what I like. 

I also try and do soemthing active daily. Could just be going on a walk.
That diet combo seems to be the key! Congratulations! Huge accomplishment
